result:
Both gates pass: `bun run typecheck` is clean and `bun test` runs 5 tests, 0 failures (the stack trace in the output is the pre-existing starter test's expected 422 logging).

`app/Http/Controllers/DashboardController.ts` now loads, for the signed-in user only, `postCount` via `Post.newQuery().where({ authorId })...count()` and `recentPosts` via the same author-scoped query ordered `createdAt desc, id desc` and limited to 5, mapped down to `{ id, title }`, and passes both alongside the existing `user` prop to `pages.dashboard.Index`; `resources/js/pages/dashboard/Index.tsx` declares `postCount: number` and `recentPosts: Array<{ id: number; title: string }>` in its `Props` and renders, below the "Signed in as" panel, a "You have N post(s)" line plus a "Recent posts" list of Inertia `Link`s to `/posts/<id>`, falling back to a "You haven't written any posts yet." message with a link to the new-post form when the list is empty. I regenerated `.guren/pages.gen.ts` for the new prop types and added `tests/DashboardController.test.ts`, which resets the test database per case and covers the guest redirect to `/login`, the count and newest-first 5-entry cap with another user's newer post excluded, and the empty state.
